items.source:
Note that this is not the same as the WebSocket session getting established
but rather the client's first attempt to connect within the sub-protocol,
for example sending the STOMP CONNECT frame.
items.translation: 请注意，这与 WebSocket 会话建立并不相同，而是客户端在子协议中的首次连接尝试，例如发送 STOMP CONNECT 帧。

items.source: source - the component that published the event (never null)
items.translation: source - 发布该事件的分量（永远不会为 null）
